balshaw_2025_cp_patellar_15wk.cohort: Balshaw et al. 2025 (n=39 completers: 19 CP vs 20 PLA, 15 wk lower-body RT, 3T MRI)

body_mass_gain_pct.note: Both groups gained body mass significantly (CP p<0.001, PLA p=0.016); no untreated control arm exists for FORCE20.

tendon_outcomes.strain_limitation: Strain measured only at fixed 80% pre-RT MVT (8.5->7.5%), NOT at the new post-RT 100% MVT (+21.4%); linear scaling yields ~11.4% (>9.0% patellar threshold).

balshaw_2025_cp_patellar_15wk.verdict: HOLD (strictly negative ADAPT25 point estimate on KE MVT -0.382 pp/wk [-0.852; +0.089], GxT p>=0.596; no CP advantage on 3T MRI PT CSA, stiffness, or strain; no untreated control arm and +2.9% mass gain disqualify FORCE20).

lee_2025_hc_patellar_12wk.cohort: Lee et al. 2025 (PMC11917387, n=20: 9 COL vs 11 PLA, 12 wk RT, middle-aged adults)

ten_rm_submax_adapt25_r09.note: Submaximal 10-RM, not 1RM/MVC; ADAPT25 point estimate is still negative (-0.383 pp/wk).

lee_2025_hc_patellar_12wk.verdict: HOLD (NO DETECTABLE STRENGTH ACCELERATION DESPITE TENDON REMODELING): Collagen significantly accelerates patellar tendon stiffness (+56.4% vs +18.9%, p=0.009), modulus (p=0.018), and CSA (+6.5% vs 0.0%, p=0.027) while reducing strain 11.3->9.1%, YET yields no statistically detectable strength/power advantage (KE MVT GxT p=0.754, pRTD p=0.637, CMJ power p=0.422); however, n=9 vs 11 leaves wide ADAPT25 95% CIs ([-0.964; +1.182] at r=0.9) that do not prove strict zero effect.

lee_2023_col_patellar_10wk.cohort: Lee et al. 2023 (PMC9910607, n=17: 8 COL vs 9 PLA, 10 wk in-season RT, female soccer players)
lee_2023_col_patellar_10wk.verdict: HOLD (PT strain stays <9.0% in COL [8.9->7.3%], but Iso KE MVC ADAPT25 CI spans zero [-1.140; +2.757] pp/wk with GxT p=0.325 and near-zero PLA rate +0.121 pp/wk; Con KE MVC is negative -0.829 pp/wk).

radovanovic_2022_hl_achilles_12wk.cohort: Radovanovic et al. 2022 (PMC9768072, n=44: 15 High-Load vs 15 Alfredson vs 14 Passive, 12 wk Achilles tendinopathy RCT)
radovanovic_2022_hl_achilles_12wk.verdict: HOLD (strain-targeted high-loading genuinely increases Achilles CSA +8.98%, stiffness +20.1%, and lowers max strain -12.4% p=0.001, YET PF MVC rises only +7.2% [1.72; 12.68]% — far below FORCE20 — and explosive CMJ height decreases -0.63 cm p=0.005; tendinopathic clinical cohort).

summary_ruling: Testing a new internal biological mechanism — hydrolysed/bioactive collagen peptides + heavy RT across 3 double-blind RCTs on the patellar tendon (Balshaw 2025 n=39, Lee 2025 n=20, Lee 2023 n=17) plus strain-targeted Achilles loading (Radovanovic 2022 n=44) — yields 0/4 cohorts closing Stage 1. In Lee 2025 and Radovanovic 2022, significant tendon remodeling (stiffness +20..+56%, CSA +6.5..+9.0%, strain reduction) was not accompanied by statistically detectable ADAPT25 or FORCE20 strength superiority (KE MVT GxT p=0.754 in Lee 2025, though wide n=9 vs 11 CIs do not prove strict zero effect; PF MVC +7.2% with CMJ decline in Radovanovic 2022). In the largest trial (Balshaw 2025 n=39), ADAPT25 KE MVT is -0.382 [-0.852; +0.089] pp/wk (p>=0.596), practically ruling out a large +25% acceleration, while collagen also did not significantly alter tendon remodeling (p>=0.365). Stage 1 remains HOLD / DATA_BLOCKED.
